title: Nutty Light Syrian Pickle Pilaf
description: A light and flavorful Syrian pilaf featuring pickles, confit tomato, and a blend of herbs and spices, suitable for ovo-vegetarian diets. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or lunch.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the toasted pine nuts and cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently.
Add the chopped pickles, confit tomato, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the rinsed basmati rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the pickle and tomato mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
